title: Senior Systems Engineer
description_text:
Job Summary: The Sr System Engineer is responsible for supporting the development, analysis, and integration of linear, non-linear, and digital control systems by collaborating closely with customers to understand technical requirements and mission needs. The position works across design and development domains to create, review, and document system-level operational concepts, ensuring seamless platform integration and rigorous verification and validation of complex system designs against functional specifications. Additional responsibilities include contributing to proposal development through technical writing, cost estimating, and presentations, as well as producing high‑quality technical documentation, specifications, and standards. The role requires strong communication skills, the ability to work both independently and with internal and external stakeholders, and a willingness to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10-15% of the time. Responsibilities and Tasks: Attend customer meetings for the purpose of understanding their requirements related to linear and non-linear control systems including digital controls
Work with the design and development domain control systems
Review, develop and document system level operational concepts and mission statements
Understand platform integration requirements at the platform level
Verification and validation of highly complex system designs to ensure conformance with functional specifications and customer requirements
Support proposal development activities, including proposal text development, cost estimating and presentation activities
Produce and/or review technical documents, specifications and standards
Ability to effectively document and communicate designs, results, reports, status and presentations
Work independently and with internal/external organizations Education, Experience, License, or Certification: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering or other relevant degree
5+ years of experience in Servo Control, Motion Control, or Navigation.
Proven experience in classical linear and non-linear control including digital control preferred Skills and Abilities: Knowledge of approximation and Kalman filters
Knowledge of inertial sensors
Working knowledge of C language and MATLAB is a must.
Experience with design and development in time and frequency domain control systems
Ability in development of models and simulations of dynamic systems in Simulink Travel/Physical Requirements: Willingness to travel domestically and internationally 10-15% travel will be required for the position. #LI-AH1

title: Manager Engineering - FWO MTC
description_text:
Job Summary: The Manager of Systems Engineering serves in a dual-capacity role, functioning as both the lead Systems Engineer and the direct people manager for the Systems Engineering team. In this role, the manager performs requirements analysis and management, technical planning, systems-level design, integration, verification and validation, cost and risk management, and supportability and effectiveness analyses across the full product lifecycle - from concept and design through prototyping, testing, installation, operation, and sustainment.
As the technical lead, the Manager guides the development of new defense systems and components, working within System and Integrated Product Teams to ensure system architectures, requirements, and engineering decisions align with mission and customer needs. As the people leader, the Manager provides direct supervision within the business unit, ensuring that products and services are delivered in response to customer requirements. The Manager executes the strategic plan by achieving goals and objectives in quality, process improvement, resource planning, and financial performance for assigned programs. Responsibilities and Tasks: Lead full‑lifecycle systems engineering activities including requirements analysis, architecture development, integration, verification, and validation.
Oversee system concept development, design, prototyping, testing, installation, fielding, and sustainment.
Transition advanced technologies from R&D and early concepts into production baselines and operational systems.
Direct and support software and hardware integration, including hands‑on troubleshooting of complex multifunctional systems.
Apply technical expertise across avionics, ground combat systems, vehicle architectures, mission systems, and survivability subsystems.
Develop system‑level requirements, CONOPS, mission needs, and interface definitions aligned to customer objectives.
Produce, review, and approve system documentation including specifications, standards, safety artifacts, test plans, and procedures.
Execute Model‑Based Systems Engineering practices to define architectures, conduct analyses, and guide system development.
Lead trade studies and evaluate alternatives to optimize system performance, cost, reliability, and schedule.
Coordinate cross‑functional engineering activities, ensuring technical integrity, cost discipline, schedule adherence, and customer satisfaction.
Serve as primary customer interface, capturing the Voice of the Customer and translating needs into actionable requirements and technical direction.
Lead, mentor, and develop engineering staff, driving workforce planning, performance evaluation, role alignment, and team collaboration.
Build a high‑trust, collaborative team environment by resolving conflicts, delegating effectively, and promoting diverse perspectives.
Direct cost‑efficient execution of department tasks, including cost estimating, budget planning, proposal development, and business development support.
Foster strong partnerships across business units while modeling organizational core values and performing additional duties assigned by leadership. description_text:
Job Summary:The Manager Supply Chain is responsible for the strategic, tactical and operational activities to achieve a value-added supply chain responsive to program requirements. Works under the direction of the Sr. Manager, Supply Chain in the preparation and execution of contract mechanisms, including purchase orders and major framework agreements with suppliers. - Communicate non-support of MRP need, specifically, material shortages, supplier issues, actions taken to resolve, committed resolution dates to Senior Manager, Supply Chain. Skills and Abilities:- Proven background in management of Supply Chain, Procurement and Material Planning Staff. - Strong knowledge of commodity purchasing practices. - Quality assurance systems and methods. - Strong communication skill both verbal and electronic. - Aware of technical aspects associated with the production of the goods to be produced. - Strong program/project management experience. - FAR/DFAR - strong working knowledge. - Aerospace, Military or similar industry experience. - Demonstrated electronic/mechanical knowledge. - Knowledge of fixed pricing agreements and supplier managed inventory.
